discrepancies.description: 48 payments.csv charge rows have status=failed or status=pending. Per policy rule 1 these are export noise and are never counted; excluded from both charges and the naive sum.

5 captured charge rows are internal QA traffic (payment customer_email and matching order customer_email both end in @qa.internal: qa+398, qa+945, qa+319, qa+825, qa+755). Per policy rule 2 excluded entirely; no QA refund rows were found.

2 pairs of captured charges share identical (order_id, gross_amount) and were posted within 3 hours of each other (ORD-0101-00010/$169.84 at 01:38 and 04:38 on 7/6; ORD-0101-00007/$112.15 at 16:01 and 19:01 on 7/9) — same real-world charge double-posted by the processor. Counted once per rule 3; the later duplicate of each pair is dropped.

2 captured, non-test charge rows reference order_ids absent from orders.csv (storefront export dropped these order rows). Processor is system of record for cash so both are counted per rule 4; each has a corroborating shipment for the same order_id, confirming they are real fulfilled orders, not noise.

8 orders marked completed in July have no corresponding payment row in the July payments export (order placed near month end, cash likely captured in August). Per policy these contribute $0 to July recognized revenue and are out of scope for the total; listed here as timing items only. (21 additional cancelled orders also have no payment row — expected $0, not a discrepancy.)
